Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring qualifying patients or designated providers to obtain permits to grow or provide medical marijuana.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to requiring qualifying patients or designatedproviders to obtain permits to grow or provide medical marijuana; andadding a new section to chapter 69.51A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 69.51A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A qualifying patient or designated provider who grows or providescannabis or cannabis products for the medical use of marijuana inaccordance with the provisions of this chapter must obtain a permitfrom the city, town, or county in order to grow or provide medicalmarijuana in the city, town, or county. In order to obtain a permit,the applicant must provide the city, town, or county with the name ofthe applicant, the address where the medical marijuana is grown, thenumber of marijuana plants grown at the address, and a copy of theapplicant's valid documentation or a copy of the qualifying patient'svalid documentation to whom the medical marijuana is provided. Thecity, town, or county may impose a maximum fee of twentyfive dollarsfor the permit. A qualifying patient or designated provider who has p. 1 HB 2511obtained a permit must notify the city, town, or county within fivebusiness days of any change in the required information provided forthe original permit.
